Buran Ghati: Where The Trail Ends

Shimla — Janglik — Dayara Thachh — Litham — Chandernahan — Dhunda — Buran Pass — Barua — Shimla

About This Trip

Buran Ghati is the boundary where Shimla’s lush soul meets Kinnaur’s rugged spirit. Known as the "Untouched Frontier," this 7-day high-altitude trek takes you from the historic wooden homes of Janglik to the vast Dayara Meadows, sacred Chandernahan glacial lakes, and base camp at Dhunda. Experience the thrilling technical descent down vertical snow walls using ropes before concluding in the fairytale village of Barua.

Itinerary

Drive through Pabbar Valley and apple orchards to Janglik village. Stay in a traditional wooden homestay and explore local village life.

Ascend through dense oak and pine forests until the trees give way to the expansive golden-green Dayara Thachh meadows. Camp under the stars.

Walk across undulating grasslands and small stream crossings to Litham. Enjoy dramatic views of the Pabbar River confluence and glacier.

Steep ascent to the sacred Chandernahan glacial lakes. Reach the Fifth Lake for acclimatization and return to Litham campsite.

Ascend into the rugged alpine landscape of Dhunda at the base of Buran Pass. Receive safety briefings on snow-wall navigation.

Tackle the summit push and rappel down the vertical snow wall on the Kinnaur side. Descend into Barua village through orchards.

Enjoy a final breakfast in Barua before driving back through the mountains to Shimla, arriving by late evening.
